intro.h2: Bathrooms done right, start to finish
paragraphs: CNG Construction Inc handles bathroom remodeling in Buffalo the full way: new tile, shower, vanity, plumbing and fixtures, with owner Craig on site and his employee Mike alongside him.

Homeowners keep repeating the same things about them. They start on the exact day promised at contract signing, they finish in the time frame they commit to, and while your job is in progress it gets their full focus. Craig is also a problem solver. For one cottage renovation he came up with his own design for a set of stairs that had to meet code in a very tight spot, and built it himself. That same care shows in the tile work and finish details people photograph and post with their reviews.

items.name: Complete bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Master baths and full bathrooms remodeled from top to bottom: new tile, shower, vanity, plumbing and fixtures. One Buffalo couple described their finished master bath as reflecting real attention to detail, and called CNG their go-to contractor afterwards.

image.alt: Remodeled master bathroom with white vanity, white quartz-look top, chrome faucet and framed mirror

items.name: Tiled showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with subway tile walls, recessed niches lined in river rock and pebble shower floors, finished with sliding glass doors and black or chrome hardware. New tiles are the top thing reviewers mention on CNG's Google profile.

image.alt: Large-format white tile shower with recessed niche, handheld shower and pebble tile floor

items.name: Basement finishing
items.blurb: Framing, drywall, flooring and the electrical work that ties it together. One recent customer said CNG sorted out a tricky panel situation, coordinated the inspections smoothly and turned a basement they had put off for years into a finished space in about three weeks.

image.alt: Finished basement with grey vinyl plank floor, black trim, recessed lights and a wrapped support post

items.name: Custom stairs and carpentry
items.blurb: When a standard part will not fit, Craig designs one. In a cottage renovation he custom built a set of oak stairs to meet code in a very challenging area, using his own design for the winding treads.

image.alt: Custom-built oak staircase with winding treads and square newel posts in a renovated cottage

items.name: Whole-house and kitchen renovations
items.blurb: Bigger projects too. For one cottage CNG reframed the floor, reinforced the ceiling, did two full bathroom remodels and a kitchen remodel. Kitchen remodeling is part of the same crew's work, so one contractor can handle several rooms.

image.alt: White subway tile shower with black towel bar on the sliding glass door, from a full cottage renovation

about.h2: Meet Craig and the CNG crew
about.text: CNG Construction Inc is a Buffalo remodeling company run by owner Craig, who works on the jobs himself with his employee Mike. Most of the work is bathrooms, from master bath remodels to complete gut jobs with new tile, shower, vanity, plumbing and fixtures, but the same crew finishes basements and renovates whole houses. Customers describe a team that comes and works hard every day, listens to what you want and offers practical suggestions that save money without cutting corners. Several reviewers say they would hire CNG again and now treat them as their go-to contractor.

items.name: Miranda E.
items.text: Last month we decided to finally tackle the basement renovation we'd been putting off for years. After getting quotes from several companies, we went with this crew based on their solid references and transparent pricing. From the first meeting they listened carefully to what we wanted and offered practical suggestions that actually saved us money without cutting corners. The framing, drywall, and flooring all came out beautifully. They handled a tricky electrical situation with the panel and coordinated the inspections smoothly. The whole process took about three weeks and we now have a gorgeous finished space that added real value to our home. I'd absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable contractors.

items.name: Juliana C.
items.text: Craig and his team are the best contractors we (my family and I) have ever worked with. My mom hired CNG to remodel a cottage she bought from top to bottom. They reframed the floor, reinforced the ceiling, did two full bathroom remodels, a kitchen remodel … the list goes on. Craig even custom built a set of stairs to meet code in a very challenging area. He literally came up with his own design. I will attach some before and after photos. I highly recommend them. They came and worked hard every day. They’re professional, quick and serious about what they do. (Note image of stairs are not finished- railings still need to go up but they’re beautiful!)

items.name: Gerry M.
items.text: We couldn't be happier with our complete master bathroom remodel recently completed by CNG Construction in Sept 2021.  Craig, the owner and his employee Mike were true professionals in all aspects of the job and the finished bathroom reflects their talent, attention to detail and dedication to delivering a high-quality master bath that we will enjoy for years to come.  They were also ON-TIME in all aspects of the project from from scheduling an appointment to provide an estimate, to starting the job the exact day promised at contract signing to completing the job in the time frame they committed to which minimized the disruption to our home that any remodel job brings.  While our job was in-process, it was their only focus from job start to completion.  CNG Construction is now our "go to" contractor and comes highly recommended !!

service_area.text: CNG Construction Inc is based at 33 Traymore St in Buffalo, New York, and its reviewed projects are bathrooms, basements and whole-house renovations for Buffalo homeowners. If you are in Buffalo or close by and planning a bathroom, a basement or a bigger renovation, email cngconstructioninc@gmail.com with your address and a short description of the job, and Craig can tell you whether it fits his schedule.

items.q: What does a CNG bathroom remodel include?
items.a: Reviewers describe complete remodels with all new tiles, shower, vanity, plumbing and fixtures. Recent bathrooms include subway tile showers with river rock floors and niches, sliding glass doors, new vanities with stone-look tops, dark tile wainscot and a heated towel radiator.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the job, and CNG gives you a time frame when you sign. Customers say they started on the exact day promised and finished within the committed time frame. One basement with framing, drywall, flooring and electrical work took about three weeks.

items.q: Who will be working in my house?
items.a: Owner Craig works on the projects himself, together with his employee Mike. Reviewers mention them by name and describe them as professional, hard working every day and serious about what they do, with your job as their only focus while it is in progress.

items.q: Do you do more than bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. CNG also finishes basements, does kitchen remodels and takes on whole-house renovations. For one cottage they reframed the floor, reinforced the ceiling, remodeled two full bathrooms and a kitchen, and custom built a staircase to meet code in a tight space.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Email cngconstructioninc@gmail.com with your address, the room you want remodeled and a few photos if you have them. CNG will schedule an appointment to see the space and provide an estimate. Customers say the team was on time for that first appointment too.

final_cta.h2: Planning a new bathroom in Buffalo?
final_cta.text: Send Craig a note about your project and set up an estimate visit.
